*Hetusahetukadukādi, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.25) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* division of the Pali Tipiṭaka. Structural analysis indicated by its title situates the text within the combinatorial matrix of the *Paṭṭhāna*, specifically treating the conditional relations of dyads beginning with root and associated with root (*hetusahetukadukādi*) in conjunction with the triad of the wholesome (*kusalattika*).
